rationale: C03 is a highly specific country-substitution template for the child. It uses the same statutory authorization, reciprocity assurances, two historical copyright proclamations, two-part definition of covered works, finding of disrupted facilities, one-year extension, and detailed limitation on copyright term and pre-proclamation liability. The child closely reproduces this sequence and language while substituting Austria, Austrian dates, and the relevant historical proclamations. C06 and C25 embody the same machinery but differ more in their recital structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the President is authorized, in accordance with the conditions prescribed in section 9 of title 17 ... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the President is authorized, in accordance with the conditions prescribed in section 9 of title 17 ... to grant an extension of time for fulfillment of the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws
shared_material.explanation: The opening authorization recital is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: That with respect to (1) works of citizens of Austria which were first produced or published outside the United States ... and (2) works of citizens of Austria subject to renewal of copyright
shared_material.parent_excerpt: That with respect to (1) works of citizens of Denmark which were first produced or published outside the United States ... and (2) works of citizens of Denmark subject to renewal of copyright
shared_material.explanation: The operative provision preserves the distinctive two-category structure while changing the country and applicable dates.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there has existed during several years ... such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance with the conditions and formalities ... and that, accordingly, the time ... is hereby extended ... for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: there has existed during several years ... such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance with the conditions and formalities ... and that, accordingly, the time ... is hereby extended ... for one year after the date of this proclamation
shared_material.explanation: The central factual finding and remedy are reproduced nearly word for word.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It shall be understood that the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected by this proclamation ... no liability shall attach ... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It shall be understood that the term of copyright in any case is not and cannot be altered or affected by this proclamation ... no liability shall attach ... for lawful uses made or acts done prior to the effective date
shared_material.explanation: The child carries over the same detailed savings and reliance-protection clause, including continuation of existing business undertakings for one year.
